broadcast-writes.boundary: Creating drafts and pausing/cancelling are available; sending, scheduling and recipients await spending validation and atomic mutation guarantees.
broadcast-writes.session_required: Sign in to view and operate broadcasts. The demo does not send campaigns.
broadcast-writes.load_error: Could not load broadcasts or permissions. Refresh to try again.
broadcast-writes.readonly: You have viewing access. Actions require permissions for campaigns and the selected channel.
broadcast-writes.name: Name
broadcast-writes.no_channels: No eligible numbers with management permission for this template.
broadcast-writes.unsupported: This template has a format or variables that cannot be configured here yet.

broadcast-writes.missing_active_account: Your session has no active account. Choose an account in Danil and renew your session.

broadcast-writes.reloaded: State refreshed. Review the list before retrying the operation.
broadcast-writes.reloaded_contacts: Registered recipients: {{count}}. Review the result before adding contacts again.
broadcast-writes.not_sent: The operation was not sent. Try again when your session is available.
